scope: Hover coverage and popup background-pixel responsiveness for every disabled QtQuick hint target in both QtQuick5 and QtQuick6, under four KDE color schemes.

runtime.profiles: Independent disposable HOME, kdeglobals, color-schemes and private D-Bus/network namespace for each scheme/version run

method.conditions: Tooltip remained within screen bounds, did not overlap its owning control and closed after pointer leave. No disabled control was activated.
method.pixel_sampling: Mode in interior of each captured popup; separate text-region scan confirmed contrasting glyph pixels were present. Every screenshot has hash in samples.
method.probe_readiness: After initial empty-matrix attempts, the probe waits up to 5 seconds for all seven disabled targets to materialize before traversing pages.

palette_role_finding.QtQuick5: Observed background mode matched the scheme Colors:Tooltip background in all four schemes (where Tooltip and Window values differed, the Tooltip role matched).
palette_role_finding.QtQuick6: Observed background mode matched Colors:Window in BreezeLight and BreezeDark; DomainOS and Irixium have identical Tooltip and Window values, so those two runs cannot distinguish the role.
palette_role_finding.interpretation: All four schemes affected rendered pixels, but semantic tooltip role is inconsistent between QtQuick5 and the QtQuick6 attached native path. Keep T07 open and investigate the QtQuick6 style path; do not replace this with fixed RGB values.

diagnostics.initial_probe_issue: Some first attempts observed no target because QML targets had not materialized; these zero-target runs are not product failures and were excluded from the final 8 matrices. A readiness guard fixed the enumeration race and all seven targets passed. An initial output-directory collision was also preserved under ~/tempia.

limitations: These are disabled controls only; enabled controls and other layouts/popup positions are not included in this palette matrix.
Scheme responsiveness does not prove historical HP VUE fidelity or full contrast compliance.
QtQuick6 Tooltip semantic role mismatch remains open pending style-path diagnosis.
next: Inspect the effective QtQuick6 attached ToolTip component and its Kirigami color set under a complete KDE platform environment; reconcile the observed Window role with the scheme Tooltip role without static colors.
